=== Overview ===
It is enshrined on the east side of {{ill|Shizuoka Prefectural Road Route 120|Q11663279|qid=Q11663279|lt=Route 120}}, just before {{ill|Yumigahama Beach|Q135752290|qid=Q135752290|lt=Yumigahama}}, in the center of the Minato district on the east bank of the Aono River in southeastern Minamiizu.

Its founding is unknown, but it is identified as one of the three seats of '''Takama Shrine''' (たかま(つくまの)じんじゃ) (deity: Monoimina-no-Mikoto, child of Mishima Daimyōjin), and is said to have been moved to its present site in {{ill|1192|Q19739|qid=Q19739}} (Kenkyū 3)<ref name="gen">[https://genbu.net/data/izu/waka_title.htm 若宮神社] - Genbu</ref><ref name="engi">[http://engishiki.org/izu/bun/iz140142-03.html 若宮神社] - Study of Engishiki Shrines</ref>.

=== Enshrined deity ===
* Monoimina-no-Mikoto (ものいみなのみこと)
